chunks.arabic_text: ٣١٨٢ - وَرُوِيَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ الْبَزَنْطِيِّ قَالَ

translations.en: 3182 - It is narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazanṭī, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَرَأْتُ كِتَابَ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: «أَبْلِغْ شِيعَتِي أَنَّ زِيَارَتِي تَعْدِلُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَلْفَ حَجَّةٍ»

translations.en: I read the letter of Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام: "Convey to my Shi'a that my visitation is equivalent, with Allah the Exalted, to one thousand hajj."

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَلْفَ حَجَّةٍ

translations.en: He said: I said to Abū Jaʿfar—meaning his son—عليه السلام, "One thousand hajj?"

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «إِي وَاللَّهِ وَأَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَجَّةٍ لِمَنْ زَارَهُ عَارِفًا بِحَقِّهِ».

translations.en: He said: "Yes, by Allah, and one thousand thousand hajj for the one who visits him knowing his right."

en.summary: This hadith conveys the immense reward of visiting Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, describing it as equal to many hajj in the sight of Allah تعالى. It further emphasizes that this reward is especially عظیم for the one who visits him with ma'rifah of his right and rank.
en.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام with recognition of his right?

key_terms.زِيَارَتِي: my visitation; the act of visiting the Imam's shrine
key_terms.شِيعَتِي: my Shi'a; the followers and adherents of the Imam
key_terms.تَعْدِلُ: is equivalent to; carries the value of
key_terms.أَلْفَ حَجَّةٍ: one thousand hajj; a measure of immense spiritual reward
key_terms.عَارِفًا بِحَقِّهِ: knowing his right; recognizing his true rank, authority, and due
